plotEn: Olga lives a strictly regulated, solitary life in a vast block of flats, with no friends or close relationships. When financial necessity forces her to rent out a room, a man moves in and secretly brings along his nine-year-old son. To her own surprise, Olga begins to form an unlikely bond with the child. As her carefully controlled world starts to shift, the lives of the three strangers gradually and unexpectedly become intertwined.
